cases.limitation_note: Retrieval succeeded in extracting the verbatim physical dimensions section. The deterministic regex extractor failed because interstitial sentence phrasing ('of component COMP-C01 is') led to extracting unit 'is', triggering unit guardrails.
cases.explanation: Evidence unit 'is' is unsupported. Only ['cm', 'mm'] are supported.

cases.description: Thickness represented in table with separate parameter, value, and unit columns: 15.0 mm vs recorded 15.0 cm -> propose 1.5 cm.
cases.limitation_note: Multi-column table cells are extracted by pypdf as individual separate lines ('Thickness\n15.0\nmm'). Line-by-line scanning cannot correlate the attribute name with values and units located in subsequent table lines.
cases.explanation: Supplier document specifies 15.0 mm, which converts via deterministic arithmetic to 1.50 cm (15.0 mm * 0.1 cm/mm = 1.50 cm). Recorded value is 15.0 cm. Proposing correction to 1.5 cm.

cases.description: Thickness label and measurement split across lines: 2.4 mm vs recorded 2.4 cm -> propose 0.24 cm.
cases.limitation_note: Retrieval splits extracted page text strictly on newlines and processes each line in isolation. When an attribute label and its numeric measurement are wrapped across a newline, neither line individually matches candidate extraction.
cases.explanation: Supplier document specifies 2.4 mm, which converts via deterministic arithmetic to 0.24 cm (2.4 mm * 0.1 cm/mm = 0.24 cm). Recorded value is 2.4 cm. Proposing correction to 0.24 cm.

cases.description: Thickness listed alongside length and width: thickness is 6.0 mm vs recorded 0.6 cm -> values agree, no_change.
cases.limitation_note: Candidate passage regex matches the nearest numeric token following 'thickness' (which matches the adjacent length '60.0 mm' after the closing parenthesis). As a result, the pipeline extracts the wrong dimension (60.0 mm instead of 6.0 mm) and proposes an incorrect correction (6.0 cm) instead of no_change.
cases.explanation: Evidence states 6.0 mm (6.0 mm * 0.1 cm/mm = 0.60 cm), which agrees with the recorded value 0.6 cm. No change required.
